Container.Name: speaches
Container.Overview: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech server (OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions and /v1/audio/speech) on Tower04's RTX 3060 Ti, the fleet's speech card. Moved here from Tower03 (where it ran on the CPU at port 8790) on 2026-11-17. API at http://10.47.40.130:8000.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: speaches listens here on the container's own IP (10.47.40.130).

Config.Name: Model cache
Config.Description: Downloaded speech models (Hugging Face hub cache).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID (nvidia-smi -L). Default = Tower04 RTX 3060 Ti, the speech card. Never the Quadro: that card belongs to the Hindsight memory model.

Config.Name: Chat completion URL
Config.Description: Only used by speaches' built-in voice-chat page. Transcription and speech work without it.

Config.Name: Chat completion API key
Config.Description: OmniRoute key for the voice-chat page. Type it here yourself; leave empty if you do not use that page.

Config.Name: Keep voice model loaded
Config.Description: Seconds a text-to-speech model (Kokoro) stays on the card after its last use. -1 = never unload (locked).
